where_to_look: 12 estimates and the most-watched retail print of the week, so the room is narrow - but the 9.42% implied move is the LOWEST of the twelve chains on the day, against a company that cut FY26 guidance twice and is changing CEO. Test whether the option market is under-pricing dispersion rather than hunting the fundamentals

The CEO transition is the specific unpriced mechanic: incoming CEO Heidi O'Neill (ex-Nike) starts in September per June reporting. A brand-new CEO arriving days after the print is the classic setup for a kitchen-sink reset of the FY guide that consensus models as a mere reaffirm

China Mainland: lululemon's only growth engine and the segment least visible from US channel checks. Look at Tmall/JD flagship review counts and the China commentary in other athletic brands' June-August disclosures

US store traffic and discount depth: foot-traffic vendors' Q2 series and the depth/breadth of the 'We Made Too Much' section through July-August 2026, which is directly observable and is the margin story

Tariff arithmetic: management guided a 150bp gross-margin headwind with 100bp of offsets. The offset mechanics (vendor negotiation, selective price increases) are checkable against actual posted prices
